results.question: Among product categories (English names) with at least 100 order item rows, which 3 have the highest average freight_value? Show the English name and the average rounded to 2 decimals, highest first.

SELECT 
  COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category_name,
  ROUND(AVG(oi.freight_value), 2) AS avg_freight_value
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id

HAVING COUNT(oi.order_id) >= 100
ORDER BY avg_freight_value DESC
LIMIT 3;
